title: Transitions and transforms
summary: Move, scale and rotate elements with transform, and animate changes smoothly with transition.

options: Draws the element 10 percent larger without moving other elements
quiz.explain: `scale` multiplies the visual size. Transforms do not change the layout, so neighbours stay where they are.

quiz.q: Move an element 20px to the right.
quiz.explain: `translateX` moves along the horizontal axis. `translateY` moves vertically. `translate(x, y)` does both.

quiz.q: Where should `transition` be written so a button fades back smoothly after the mouse leaves?
quiz.explain: The transition setting of the state you are moving **to** is used. Put it on the base rule and it works for hover-in and for hover-out.

quiz.q: How many seconds does this transition last? Type just the number of seconds.
quiz.explain: The pattern is property, duration, timing function. Here only `background-color` is animated, over 0.3 seconds.

exercise.task:
Style the `.btn` and a rotated label. Work in `index.html`.

- `.btn`: `transition` that animates `background-color` over `0.3s` (write it on the base rule).
- `.btn:hover`: `background-color` of `darkblue` and `transform: scale(1.1)`.
- `.tilt`: `transform: rotate(-5deg)`.
- `.btn` must have `display: inline-block` so transforms apply cleanly.
hints: A transition names a property and a time. A hover rule changes the end state.
Put transition on `.btn`, and the new colour and scale on `.btn:hover`. `rotate()` uses degrees.

checks.name: A .btn:hover rule changes the background to darkblue
